notes: CalibForge is decisively the best corpus for this task: its mathematics/* slice contains genuine textbook cryptanalysis (SPN linear attacks, LFSR correlation attacks, knapsack/RSA breaks) with the same 'write /app/plaintexts.txt' deliverable, and beats everything in the v1 pool. TMax-15K is second and has a dozen genuine known-plaintext key-recovery tasks, though most bolt the cryptanalysis onto unrelated forensics phases. Terminal-Lego-15k has essentially no cryptanalysis, only library-usage AES tutorials; its list is filler below rank 2. TerminalWorld could not field 10 defensible candidates - half are FREE crackmes. Recursive-Task-Synthesis offers only near-duplicate crackme reversals (all absent verifier). SWE-Smith and SWE-Rebench have nothing on skill; their entries are bit-packing/binary-codec defects picked for the nearest adjacent capability and should be weighted down at merge.
